reviewed.source: integrations/puredarwin/chonkstep-darwin/client-terminal: revision-1 freeze 293f8863 (14 files), plus the revision-2 change to src/pty.rs. Every other file matches the revision-1 record; attempts/revision-001 preserves the old pty.rs.
reviewed.revision2_change: Adds CTTY_REQUEST: libc::c_ulong (on Apple, libc::TIOCSCTTY as c_ulong; elsewhere libc::TIOCSCTTY) and uses it in the child's TIOCSCTTY ioctl. A pure type fix; behaviour unchanged.
reviewed.native_binary: Root reports a209732a (1804752 bytes; wayland-terminal-native-build-002.json). Bind it to this source in the packet review.

verdict: APPROVE revision 2 for packet assembly, after the PTY smoke passes on hardware. Real PTY in and out, XKB-only input, checked session ownership and cleanup, correct Wayland buffer lifetime and a strict, echo-resistant proof gate. TA-TC are small consistency or cost items.

verified.pty_and_session: Everything is allocated before fork (path, argv, env, close bound), and fork happens in run() before any Wayland connection, so the process is single-threaded. posix_openpt(O_RDWR|O_NOCTTY), checked grantpt/unlockpt/ptsname_r with an owned 128-byte buffer, slave O_RDWR|O_NOCTTY, explicit termios (ICRNL; OPOST|ONLCR; ICANON|ISIG|IEXTEN|ECHO|ECHOE|ECHOK; CS8|CREAD; standard cc) and checked TIOCSWINSZ. Internal fds are kept above 2 and CLOEXEC; only the master is non-blocking. Child: setsid, TIOCSCTTY, dup2 to 0/1/2 with CLOEXEC cleared, postconditions, signal reset (including CHLD and PIPE), closes 3..OPEN_MAX except the status pipe, a 16-byte READY record with pid/sid/group, then execve('/bin/sh', ['sh','-i','+m']). Environment: TERM=dumb, LC_ALL=C, ENV=/dev/null, ZDOTDIR nonexistent, HISTFILE=/dev/null, PS1='$ ', which matches T1 (zsh sh-emulation reads only $ENV when interactive). Exec success requires READY followed by status EOF; any second record fails.
verified.io_only_input_and_render: Only master reads feed the grid, RX record and proof (at most 16 x 4 KiB per loop turn). Only XKB-translated wl_keyboard presses feed TX. Writes go only to the master, only after READY, and only while tcgetpgrp == the shell pid (+m keeps jobs in the shell group). pty-tx.bin records exactly the accepted prefix. There is no command injection, canned output or expected-text drawing: the renderer rasterises the grid with real IBM Plex Mono outlines (font sha 6a3412f0, byte-identical to the Chonkstep wm-theme asset).
verified.xkb: The compositor keymap string is compiled with no environment names or default includes. State comes only from wl_keyboard.modifiers (update_mask). Keys are keycode+8 to keysym/UTF-8; Return gives CR (ICRNL gives NL), BackSpace 127, Tab 9, Esc 27. Releases and modifiers alone produce no bytes. There is no client-side key repeat (repeat_info is ignored), which settles K1. Text before READY, a duplicate press, a held-key array over the bound and a focus leave with queued input all fail.
verified.cleanup: Each signal re-checks whether the child is now its own session/group leader and targets -pid only then; an unreaped pid cannot be recycled. TERM, 250 ms, KILL, 2 s bounded WNOHANG reap; ESRCH is tolerated; owned fds are closed once. It is idempotent, Drop runs the same path, and run() always cleans up before writing result.json. DONE requires cleanup.complete and the response. No kill(0)/kill(-1) and no reliance on master close.
verified.wayland_lifetime: Async registry sync, bounded 3 s non-blocking connect, ack_configure, and SSD ServerSide set before the first commit. A redraw requires SSD ready, wl_buffer.release and the previous frame callback (FrameState). The SHM file is created with create_new 0600 and unlinked; size arithmetic is checked and capped at 32 MiB; a resize is accepted only after release+frame and within the bounded grid. Teardown destroys decoration before toplevel. Disconnect (POLLHUP/ERR/NVAL) is an error. prepare_read/read is used, and POLLOUT is requested only when the flush would block.
verified.proof:
READY is armed only when the PTY is exec-checked with output and not at EOF, the keymap is parsed, the surface has own focus with no held keys and neutral modifiers, SSD is acknowledged, and a frame callback has completed for a commit made after PTY output. RESPONSE fires once and needs the exact '
DLT_<nonce>
Darwin
arm64
25.5.0
' in post-READY raw bytes with only CR removed. Echo of the typed command ('DLT_%s%s' with quote-separated halves) cannot form it.
verified.darwin_pty_semantics: XNU ptcread returns 0 (EOF) once the slave disconnects (TS_CONNECTED clear) and EWOULDBLOCK when non-blocking, which matches the Darwin branch (EIO-as-EOF only on Linux).
verified.tests: cargo test --offline --locked in a scratch target: 26/26 OK (the printed xkbcommon syntax error is a negative fixture).

findings.text: The terminal allows up to 1 MiB of PTY RX (MAX_RX) but the terminal-records collector refuses pty-rx.bin above 256 KiB. A large transcript would be refused at export, which fails closed. Align the caps. The fixed qualification command produces only a few KiB.
The argv nonce check accepts uppercase hex (is_ascii_hexdigit), but the host helper and collector require lowercase. Restrict it to [0-9a-f] for one consistent contract.
Proof::receive re-normalises the whole post-READY buffer on every read, which is quadratic up to 1 MiB. Keeping only a rolling window of len(expected)-1 bytes across reads would make it linear.

The child resets dispositions with libc::signal after fork. Darwin's implementation wraps sigaction, but sigaction is the POSIX async-signal-safe call. TIOCSWINSZ is also not read back at spawn or resize.

runtime_unknowns: Darwin /dev/ptmx clone/grant/unlock and controlling-tty behaviour (the PTY smoke runs first)
zsh-as-sh interactive output under TERM=dumb (T2: line-editor bytes appear in RX and the grid)
